modified_s15_standalone.description: S15 with v8 settings (cap=3). OPENCLAW_S15_INSIDER_OPPORTUNISTIC=1, OPENCLAW_S12_SELL_CLUSTER=0
modified_s15_standalone.notes: v8 BREAKS the v6→v7 trend. Standalone Sharpe REGRESSED from v7's +0.58 to v8's -0.74 (-1.32 absolute) — by a wider margin than v6's drop from v4. Trade count fell 394→277 (~30%). The cap=3 lever is too tight: it pushed concentration past the sweet spot. Per-trade avg_pnl rose (0.0046 → 0.0060) and hit rate held strong (0.61 → 0.62 — highest of any version), but standalone MaxDD ballooned 4.02% → 6.73% (~67% increase) and return collapsed +5.00% → +1.67%. Interpretation: cap=3 selected only the 3 highest-ranked clusters per day; when those happened to be in correlated tickers (same sector / same news event), all three losers compounded. The diversification benefit of slightly more positions (cap=5) outweighed the further ranking-precision gain. The cap-axis gradient is NOT monotonic — it PEAKS at cap=5 (v7) and inflects downward at cap=3 (v8).

ablation.notes: IDENTICAL to modified_s15_standalone. Stage 2 calendar-quarter classifier remains non-discriminating — same data-depth limitation observed in v1-v7.

ablation_root_cause_analysis.finding: Classifier inert for the eighth consecutive version (data-depth limitation, not parameter-tunable).
ablation_root_cause_analysis.v8_cap_effect: Cap=3 over-concentrated. The cap-gradient picture is now clear: v4 cap=20 (Sharpe +0.28), v6 cap=8 (-0.36), v7 cap=5 (+0.58), v8 cap=3 (-0.74). NON-MONOTONIC — peaks at cap=5 with cap=8 and cap=3 both regressing. The mechanism: cap=20 admits a wide, low-edge, diversified population (mediocre Sharpe); cap=8 admits enough ranking precision that the variance reduction doesn't compensate for loser-correlation in temporal clusters (worst Sharpe); cap=5 hits a sweet spot where ranking precision + just-enough diversification combine; cap=3 falls off the cliff because the top-3 clusters per day are too often sector-correlated, blowing out daily-portfolio variance.

Per-trade avg_pnl rose 0.0046→0.0060 (+30%); hit rate climbed 0.61→0.62 (best of all 8 versions). But MaxDD ballooned 4.02%→6.73% (+67%) and return collapsed +5.00%→+1.67%. The diversification floor matters: cap=5 had enough positions to dampen loser-correlation in temporal clusters; cap=3 does not.
standalone.cap_gradient_summary: v4(20)→+0.28; v6(8)→-0.36; v7(5)→+0.58; v8(3)→-0.74. NON-MONOTONIC — peaks at v7 (cap=5) with v6 (cap=8) and v8 (cap=3) both regressing. The cap parameter has a U-inverted topology: too loose (cap=20) lacks ranking discrimination; too tight (cap=3) lacks diversification; the sweet spot is cap=5.

computed_suggestion_rationale: v8 fails G1 (Sharpe -0.74, threshold 0.5), G3, and G5. Per the decision tree, any non-G5 failure → KILL. v8 establishes the upper bound of the productive concentration cap range: tighter than v7 over-concentrates. The cap-axis sweep is now complete enough to declare a peak at cap=5 (v7). Recommend abandoning further cap-tightening and proceed to v9 (Stage 3 strict alone with cap reverted to 20) and v10 (stack v7's cap with v9's Stage 3 strictness).
